feedback.headline: Training achieved strong macro gains from 59.9% to 72.4% mean destruction over 5,425 episodes, but has plateaued since peaking at 80.4% rolling destruction at episode 4,440 due to persistent head entropy saturation and ground-vs-air multi-army interference.
feedback.progression_summary: Across the five macro phases (episodes 1 to 5,423), mean destruction improved steadily from 65.03% (1.51 stars, 5.1% triple rate in Phase 1) to 72.40% (1.86 stars, 15.5% triple rate in Phase 5) while explained variance climbed from 0.5078 to 0.7273. However, rolling-50 destruction peaked at 80.4% at episode 4,440 (983 episodes ago) and currently sits at 68.9% (-11.5% drawdown), with a flat 300-episode reward slope (+0.005/100ep) and a negative recent destruction slope (-0.903%/100ep).

what_is_going_wrong.title: Action Head Entropy Saturation Limiting Policy Sharpening
what_is_going_wrong.symptom: After 5,425 episodes, live model probe shows near-uniform conditional action distributions across all factorized heads: slot_idx saturation is 99.8% (1.018 / 1.020), slot_type is 98.1% (0.951 / 0.969), tile_xy is 96.5% (4.167 / 4.320 with top-5 tiles holding only 14.97% probability mass), and deploy_fraction is 90.3% (1.453 / 1.609).
what_is_going_wrong.root_cause: Normalized per-head entropy regularization (reg_entropy) and logits clamping keep conditional policy heads overly diffuse inside the masked valid action set, preventing the actor from committing probability mass to deterministic troop ordering and precise spatial funnel tiles once the critic has converged (EV = 0.766).

what_is_going_wrong.title: Severe Initial-State Critic Under-Calibration (V(s0) Collapse)
what_is_going_wrong.symptom: In the live model probe, predicted V(s0) is -0.05 (spanning only [-0.08, 0.09] across rollout states) against an empirical recent-50 episode return of 60.38, creating a -60.43 calibration gap despite a high within-batch explained variance of 0.766.
what_is_going_wrong.root_cause: When the live probe evaluates an un-stepped initial state or when reward/value scaling is decoupled from raw episode returns, the critic head predicts near-zero centered residuals at t=0 while late-episode terminal star and destruction bonuses (+36 star pts, +14 TH18 pts) arrive sparsely after discount attenuation across 38–47 steps.

what_is_going_wrong.title: Multi-Army Policy Interference (Air Hydra vs. Ground Smash)
what_is_going_wrong.symptom: Dragon Duke Hydra (army_idx 1) trails Thrower + Healer Smash (army_idx 0) by 14.1% recent destruction (60.4% vs. 74.5%), 0.67 stars (1.39 vs. 2.06), and nearly 4x in triple rate (5.4% vs. 20.0%), dragging down overall rolling averages whenever random matchups sample air attacks.
what_is_going_wrong.root_cause: Sharing a single spatial pointer conv head and discrete slot heads across fundamentally opposite tactical archetypes (ground wall-breach/healer funneling vs. air sweeper avoidance and Dragon Duke ability timing) causes conflicting policy gradients when trained with a small 12-episode batch across 15 army-village pairs.

what_is_going_wrong.title: High Gradient Norm Spikes Under Small Multi-Task Batching
what_is_going_wrong.symptom: Mean gradient norms remain elevated across all phases (69.2 in Phase 1, peaking at 94.7 in Phase 2, and 65.4 in Phase 5; 70.6 in prev_100) while Phase 4->5 mean destruction gained only +0.83% over 1,085 episodes.
what_is_going_wrong.root_cause: Collecting only batch_episodes=12 across 3 armies x 5 villages (15 distinct matchups) yields high inter-batch return variance (std_pct ~17.3%), producing noisy advantage estimates and large pre-clipping gradient norms across the 4 PPO epochs.

recommendations.action: Anneal the entropy regularization coefficient (ent_coef) by 3x–5x (e.g., cosine decay from initial value down to 0.002 after episode 2,500) and relax any narrow logit tanh/clamp temperature on slot_idx and tile_xy heads.
recommendations.rationale: Allowing head entropy saturation to drop from 96%–99.8% down to 40%–65% will let the policy lock in optimal troop deployment order and concentrate top-5 spatial tile probability mass above 50% instead of sampling near-uniformly among valid perimeter tiles.

recommendations.action: Apply army-indexed FiLM conditioning (scale and shift from the 64-D army_context_proj) directly onto the final spatial tile_conv_head and slot_idx_head features, and weight rollout sampling by inverse army performance or advantage.
recommendations.rationale: Explicit multiplicative modulation of the final action heads by army archetype separates air-targeting priors (avoiding Air Sweepers/Air X-Bows for Dragon Duke Hydra) from ground smash funnel priors, closing the 14.1% destruction gap.

recommendations.action: Increase batch_episodes from 12 to 24 or 30 (at least 2 full sweeps of the 15 army-village combinations per PPO update) and decay actor learning rate from 1.5e-4 to 5e-5.
recommendations.rationale: Stratifying all 15 army-village matchups within every PPO rollout buffer eliminates matchup-sampling noise—the primary driver of the -11.5% rolling-50 drawdown and 65+ grad norms—and stabilizes policy updates around the 80%+ peak.

recommendations.action: Audit value target normalization and GAE gamma/lambda (set gamma >= 0.99, gae_lambda = 0.95) or align the live probe's critic readout scale with unnormalized return units.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring V(s0) accurately reflects the ~60-point expected episode return bridges the credit-assignment gap between Phase 1 perimeter deployment (ticks 0–240) and Phase 2 core TH18 takedown rewards.
